# 1.0.9 beta 2

This beta supersedes 1.0.9 beta 1 and focuses on navigation, Settings maintainability and test
coverage.

- Reorganized Settings into General, Appearance, Diagnostics and About tabs. The tab strip stays
  visible while each pane scrolls independently and keeps its own position; keyboard navigation
  wraps in both directions, and the fixed Restore Defaults footer remains available from every tab.
- Added a dedicated Diagnostics tab for VR/OpenXR, Steam and WiVRn status, diagnostics checks,
  reports and operation logs.
- Unified the Titanfall 2 and Settings tab strips on shared navigation behavior and styling, with
  localized labels in all ten interface languages.
- Refined the Release Explorer and installation-history flows and expanded the interface catalogs
  to 606 keys per language.
- Added headless UI tests for Settings tab switching, scroll preservation, live language changes
  and Restore Defaults. Automated coverage is now 167 tests (163 Core + 4 headless UI).

The installer archive remains self-contained, checksum-verified and installable without root.
